fichas.title: Nursing and Care Homes for the Elderly
fichas.summary: Nursing and care homes provide support for chronically ill and vulnerable elderly people, with activating therapy and a separation between residential and operational areas. The page gives room-size and entrance guidelines, describes residential groups and care-department requirements, and illustrates care-room layouts and the first floor of Haus Gisingen.
